    Display the status of the internal checkrefr environment

    checkrefr_env_status.Rd

    Displays in the console a formatted summary of the current state of the internal package environment (.checkrefr_env). It is possible to restrict the display to one or more specific variables via the var argument.

    Usage

    checkrefr_env_status(var = NULL)

    Arguments

    var

    A vector of type character containing the name(s) of the internal variables to display. Default: NULL (all variables of the internal environment are displayed). The available variables are:

    mode

    Active GROBID connection mode: "docker", "remote" or NA if not configured.

    docker_port

    Local port used by the GROBID Docker container (character string, e.g. "8070").

    docker_container_id

    Identifier of the currently active GROBID Docker container, or NA if none.

    docker_image

    Name of the default GROBID Docker image used (e.g. "lfoppiano/grobid:").

    grobid_version

    GROBID version used or detected (e.g. "0.9.0").

    grobid_model_type

    Variant of the GROBID model ("crf", "full" or NA if not specified).

    server_url

    URL of the currently configured GROBID server (local or remote).

    remote_default_url

    Named list (crf/full) of default remote GROBID server URLs.

    timeout

    Maximum timeout (in seconds) for GROBID network/API calls.

    max_workers

    Maximum number of parallel processes used when processing multiple files.

    oa_probable_threshold

    Global score threshold above which an OpenAlex candidate is considered "probable".

    oa_min_threshold

    Minimal global score threshold required to retain an OpenAlex candidate.

    oa_doi_threshold

    Title score threshold from which a match via DOI is considered confirmed.

    oa_w_title

    Weight of the title score in the global OpenAlex matching score.

    oa_w_authors

    Weight of the authors score in the global OpenAlex matching score.

    oa_w_year

    Weight of the year score in the global OpenAlex matching score.

    oa_max_candidates

    Maximum number of OpenAlex candidates presented per reference.

    oa_api_key

    Key used for the OpenAlex API "polite pool".

    oa_use_window

    Boolean indicating whether a sliding window is used for author matching.

    oa_window_size

    Size (\(\pm k\)) of the sliding window used for author matching.

    oa_large_author_threshold

    Threshold above which an author list is considered "large".

    oa_min_coverage_ratio

    Minimal coverage ratio between author lists to distinguish marginal from massive truncation.

    oa_author_lambda

    Penalty factor applied in case of truncation of the author list.

    oa_sym_max_diff_abs

    Absolute tolerance for the length difference between author lists for the symmetric case.

    oa_sym_max_diff_prop

    Proportional tolerance for the length difference between author lists for the symmetric case.

    doi_email

    Email address used in the User-Agent header when making direct requests to doi.org.

    doi_max_retries

    Maximum number of attempts in case of network error or 5xx response for DOI requests.

    doi_retry_backoff

    Initial delay (in seconds) before a new attempt, doubled at each successive failure.

    Value

    A named list (invisible) containing the values of the requested variables (or all internal variables if var = NULL). This function is mainly called for its side effect of displaying to the console.

    See also

    checkrefr_env_reset, checkrefr_set_defaults

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Display the entire state of the environment
checkrefr_env_status()

# Display only certain variables
checkrefr_env_status(var = c("mode", "docker_port", "server_url"))
} # }
